card.title: Xbox Elite Controller Series 2 issues with the analog sticks repair

source.title: Xbox Elite Controller Series 2 issues with the analog sticks repair

claims.statement: Elite Series 2 stick drift or short range: clean the four potentiometers (two per stick) and replace if worn; the stick mechanism is Elite 2-specific but the pots are the same as other Xbox controllers.
Replacement pots usually need rotating to centre before soldering; bend pins on non-plated holes, or shave the locating pegs in extreme cases.

procedure: Replace worn pots, centring before soldering.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
